```{r}
# Loading packages for API calls and writing functions for extracting the MD only data from CMS
library(httr2)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(tibble)

get_cms_state <- function(dataset_id, state = "MD",
                          limit = 1000) {

  url <- paste0(
    "https://data.cms.gov/provider-data/api/1/",
    "datastore/query/",
    dataset_id,
    "/0"
  )

  response <- request(url) |>
    req_url_query(
      limit = limit,
      offset = 0,
      `conditions[0][property]` = "state",
      `conditions[0][value]` = state,
      `conditions[0][operator]` = "="
    ) |>
    req_perform()

  result <- resp_body_json(
    response,
    simplifyVector = TRUE
  )

  as_tibble(result$results) |>
    clean_names()
}

# Extracting data and check if the dataset is complete and only for Maryland
hospitals_md <- get_cms_state("xubh-q36u")
mortality_md <- get_cms_state("ynj2-r877")
readmissions_md <- get_cms_state("632h-zaca")

dim(hospitals_md)
dim(mortality_md)
dim(readmissions_md)

unique(hospitals_md$state)
unique(mortality_md$state)
unique(readmissions_md$state)
```

```{r}
# From CMS data dictionary:
# COMP-HIP-KNEE: Rate of complications for hip/knee replacement patients
# Hybrid HWM: Hybrid Hospital-Wide All-Cause Risk Standardized Mortality Rate
# MORT-30-AMI: Death rate for heart attack patients
# MORT-30-CABG: Death rate for Coronary Artery Bypass Graft (CABG) surgery patients
# MORT-30-COPD: Death rate for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) patients
# MORT-30-HF: Death rate for heart failure patients
# MORT-30-PN: Death rate for pneumonia patients
# PSI 03: Pressure sores (alternate Measure ID: PSI_3_Ulcer)
# PSI 12: Serious blood clots after surgery (alternate Measure ID: PSI-12-POSTOP-PULMEMB-DVT)
mortality_ids <- c(
  "COMP_HIP_KNEE",
  "Hybrid_HWM",
  "MORT_30_AMI",
  "MORT_30_CABG",
  "MORT_30_COPD",
  "MORT_30_HF",
  "MORT_30_PN",
  "PSI_03",
  "PSI_12"
)

readmission_ids <- c(
  "EDAC_30_AMI",
  "EDAC_30_HF",
  "Hybrid_HWR",
  "OP_35_ADM",
  "READM_30_AMI",
  "READM_30_COPD",
  "READM_30_HF",
  "READM_30_PN"
)

mortality_selected <- mortality_md |>
  filter(measure_id %in% mortality_ids)

readmissions_selected <- readmissions_md |>
  filter(measure_id %in% readmission_ids)

missing_hospitals <- hospitals_md |>
  anti_join(
    mortality_selected,
    by = "facility_id"
  ) |>
  select(
    facility_id,
    facility_name,
    hospital_type,
    hospital_overall_rating
  )

print(missing_hospitals)

class(mortality_selected$score)
class(readmissions_selected$score)

unique(mortality_selected$score)
unique(readmissions_selected$score)

mortality_selected |>
  filter(is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(score)))) |>
  count(score, sort = TRUE)

readmissions_selected |>
  filter(is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(score)))) |>
  count(score, sort = TRUE)
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)

clean_clinical_measures <- function(data) {

  data |>
    mutate(
      score_raw = score,

      across(
        c(score, denominator,
          lower_estimate, higher_estimate),
        ~ as.numeric(na_if(.x, "Not Available"))
      ),

      evidence_available = !is.na(score),
      measure_direction = "lower"
    )
}

mortality_clean <- clean_clinical_measures(
  mortality_selected
)

readmissions_clean <- clean_clinical_measures(
  readmissions_selected
)

hospitals_md_clean <- hospitals_md |>
  filter(hospital_type != "Psychiatric")
```

```{r}
check_availability <- function(data) {

  data |>
    group_by(measure_id) |>
    summarise(
      total = n(),
      available = sum(!is.na(score)),
      unavailable = sum(is.na(score)),
      availability_pct = round(
        available / total * 100, 1
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(availability_pct)
}

mortality_availability <- check_availability(
  mortality_clean
)

readmission_availability <- check_availability(
  readmissions_clean
)

print(mortality_availability)
print(readmission_availability)
```

```{r}
hospital_info <- hospitals_md_clean |>
  select(
    facility_id,
```

```{r}
library(tidygeocoder)
hospital_addresses <- hospitals_md_clean |>
  select(
    facility_id,
    facility_name,
    address,
    citytown,
    state,
    zip_code
  ) |>
  distinct()

hospital_locations <- hospital_addresses |>
  geocode(
    street = address,
    city = citytown,
    state = state,
    postalcode = zip_code,
    method = "census",
    lat = lat,
    long = lng
  )

  hospital_locations |>
  summarise(
    total = n(),
    successfully_geocoded = sum(
      !is.na(lat) & !is.na(lng)
    ),
    missing_coordinates = sum(
      is.na(lat) | is.na(lng)
    )
  )

  hospital_locations |>
  filter(is.na(lat) | is.na(lng)) |>
  select(facility_id, facility_name, address)

waypoint_md <- waypoint_md |>
  left_join(
    hospital_locations |>
      select(facility_id, lat, lng),
    by = "facility_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

  dim(waypoint_md)
```


```{r}
# Inspecting the missing coordinates and manually adding the lat/lng information for the missing hospitals 
missing_addresses <- tibble(
  facility_id = c("210016", "21007F", "21010F"),
  full_address = c(
    "11890 Healing Way, Silver Spring, MD 20904, USA",
    "4494 North Palmer Road, Bethesda, MD 20889, USA",
    "361 Boiler House Road, Perry Point, MD 21902, USA"
  )
)

missing_locations <- missing_addresses |>
  geocode(
    address = full_address,
    method = "osm",
    lat = lat,
    long = lng,
    full_results = TRUE
  )

missing_locations |>
  select(facility_id, full_address, lat, lng)

manual_locations <- tibble(
  facility_id = c("210016", "21010F"),
  lat = c(39.04966, 39.54968),
  lng = c(-76.95726, -76.06235)
)

location_corrections <- bind_rows(
  missing_locations |>
    filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lng)) |>
    select(facility_id, lat, lng),

  manual_locations
)

hospital_locations <- hospital_locations |>
  rows_patch(
    location_corrections,
    by = "facility_id"
  )

hospital_locations |>
  summarise(
    total = n(),
    available = sum(!is.na(lat) & !is.na(lng)),
    missing = sum(is.na(lat) | is.na(lng))
  )

waypoint_md <- waypoint_md |>
  select(-any_of(c("lat", "lng"))) |>
  left_join(
    hospital_locations |>
      select(facility_id, lat, lng),
    by = "facility_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

dim(waypoint_md)

sum(is.na(waypoint_md$lat))
sum(is.na(waypoint_md$lng))

waypoint_md <- waypoint_md |>
  relocate(
    facility_id,
    facility_name,
    citytown,
    state,
    lat,
    lng,
    measure_id,
    measure_name,
    score
  )

view(waypoint_md)
```
